graders.name: dated-records-kept
graders.criteria: Earlier dated entries in these files record past work under the name "pair". Pass if those earlier entries keep their wording; a new entry or a note about the rename is fine.

graders.name: keeps-uncommitted-work
graders.criteria: The working tree held uncommitted work: `SKILL.md` sends each run to one mode file, `references/panel-mode.md` for panel mode and the pair-mode file for the other. Pass if the edited `SKILL.md` still loads one file per mode.

graders.name: no-stale-name
graders.criteria: Judge the panel skill's instruction files. None still calls the mode "pair mode", a "pair consultant" or a "pair directory", apart from naming "pair" as a word that still selects the mode. A missing file counts as having no stale name.

graders.name: pair-still-selects
graders.criteria: Users have been typing "pair" to select this mode. Pass if "pair" still selects consult mode, or the final message points out that it no longer does.

graders.name: panel-mode-file-kept
graders.description: The uncommitted panel-mode.md survives the rename.

graders.name: pointers-follow
graders.criteria: These files point to the mode's instructions in `references/pair-mode.md` and cite its sections by name. Pass if every pointer now names the file's current path (renamed or not) and every cited section exists under the cited name.

graders.name: scripts-unchanged
graders.description: Only instruction and documentation files change; scripts, presets and the constitution stay.
